provenance.notes: Always install fuses or circuit breakers between panels, controllers, and batteries. Short circuits can trigger catastrophic lithium fire risks.

batteryChemistries.tempRange: -4°F to 113°F (good in heat, slow charge rate)

batteryChemistries.safety: Low to Moderate (off-gasses explosive hydrogen; must be ventilated)

applianceLoads.name: LED Lighting
applianceLoads.notes: Low draw, highly recommended for solar.

applianceLoads.name: Homestead Router
applianceLoads.notes: Steady continuous drain. Unplug at night to save power.

applianceLoads.name: Starlink Satellite Dish
applianceLoads.notes: Significant load. Turn off when not actively browsing.

applianceLoads.name: DC Fridge (High Efficiency)
applianceLoads.notes: Runs on/off compressor cycle. Avoid opening frequently.

applianceLoads.name: Charge Phone/Laptop
applianceLoads.notes: Charge directly from 12V DC ports if possible.

applianceLoads.name: Deep Well Water Pump (1/2 HP)
applianceLoads.notes: Requires high surge inverter to handle starting motor current.

applianceLoads.name: Circular Saw / Power Tools
applianceLoads.notes: Only run during peak sun periods when battery is full.

applianceLoads.name: Electric Water Kettle
applianceLoads.notes: WARNING: Extreme surge load. Rapidly drains batteries. Use propane instead.

applianceLoads.name: Electric Space Heater
applianceLoads.notes: CRITICAL: Incompatible with off-grid solar. Use wood heat instead.
